## Summary

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Include the roadmap stage and preceding PR when stacked.

## Validation

List commands and observed results. Name unverified environments and remaining acceptance checks.

## Checklist

- [ ] Focused on one roadmap stage.
- [ ] Documentation and configuration examples match the change.
- [ ] Relevant checks passed, or limitations are stated.
- [ ] No secrets or local data included.
- [ ] Ready for review; no merge or release requested.
